svg.title: Hash mod N, until N changes
svg.desc: An animation in four steps. Twenty players of an online game sign up one at a time in order of player id, and a router sends each one to database server hash(player_id) mod 4, so each of db-0 to db-3 gets five players. The four newest players sit on four different servers, so a scan over their ids has to ask all four servers. Server db-4 is added and the rule becomes hash(player_id) mod 5. Sixteen players then move one at a time while a counter counts them, and the four whose hash mod 20 is 0, 1, 2, or 3 stay on their server. Each of the five servers ends with four players.
svg.text: Hash mod N, until N changes
Hashing spreads players evenly, but every placement depends on N, so changing N moves most players.

g.text: mod 4 and mod 5 agree only when hash mod 20 < 4

svg.text: Each player goes to server hash(player_id) mod 4, and each server ends up with five. Adder hashes to 47, and 47 mod 4 = 3.
The four newest players sit on four different servers: no sign-up hot spot, but a scan over their ids asks every server.
Server db-4 is added, and the rule becomes hash(player_id) mod 5.
16 of the 20 players move: only those whose hash mod 20 is below 4 stay where they were.
Each chip shows a tag, a #player_id, and a made-up two-digit hash.
